quotes.text: Traveling in interstate highway at 70-75 mph for 60 minutes the transmission overheating light illuminated. After following instructions in the owner's manual, let the vehicle idle till the overheating light went out.
2009 Honda Ridgeline rl constantly pulls to the right. I have owned the vehicle for 6 months and had it in for alignment three times.
Steering wheel shimmies at all speeds. Tires have been changed 3 times, dealership checked 2 times, multiple alignments. The problem remains the same from about 25,000 mi. Now 66,000 mi.
Got notice in march 2016, now august and no action at this time. Very disappointed in how long this is taking. I don't feel safe driving my Ridgeline untill replacement.
Rodents chewed through wiring on a wheel sensor for the braking system. I have found out that Honda has a class action law suite for using soy based insulation on wires in 2012-2015 year models.

I was notified of the recall march 2016. Dealer still has not received the parts. No one knows when to expect them. Corporate hot line was no help. Honda should face some sort of financial penalty for this lack of concern.

Jeep Compass 2010 back seat seatbelts are very loose and do not lock. When installing a car seat there is no way to make it stable or safe that I can find due to the seat belts not staying tight. Very concerned.
Paint finish. Chips on both front doors from just touching anything with them. Also part of hood is discoloring and it has a rough finish on it.
Rear window exploded when I took my foot off the brake? Never even touched the accelerator.

Brake lights come up intermittently, especially when temperature is low. Also, front radar sensor system malfunction and smart brake system malfunction warnings come up also,. This is during the drive.
2009 Acura RDX has uncontrollable acceleration problem.
2007 Acura RDX caught fire under the hood and totally destroyed the vehicle. Neither the driver, the fire department or the insurance company was able to identify the cause of the fine.
Dec 20,2023 Manufacturer Recall Number23TB15 NHTSA Recall Number23V865 Recall StatusRecall Incomplete, remedy not yet available When will this be resolved? Can Toyota inspect my vehicle now?
Tire blew out, the outer sidewall completely came apart at the seams. There was no external pressure and there are less than 5,000 miles on the car. The PSI was at 35 as per the manufacturers spec.
Cylinder no. 5 connecting rod. Only had 1900 miles on car.
Engine locked up without warning while driving down the highway, resulting in a loss of power steering and not ability to accelerate.
Windshield wipers and stability control and other electrical problems occurred while driving thru the rain.
The rear end of this car feels as if it is slipping out when you enter a curve at 60 to 65 mph. Gm calls it sensitive steering but I call it scary and unsafe.
Total loss of power climbing a hill at freeway speed. The behavior was like the car had shifted itself into neutral. This then manifested itself three other times over the next 20 miles of driving.
The vehicle has more consistently failed to turn off the display keep seeing shift to park and it's happening with more frequency.

When car is in park the vehicle sometimes does not recognize that and will not let you turn the car off. The display tells you that you need to shift to park but it is already in park. The problem is happening frequently now.
Will not shut off when transmission shifted to park.
1. Intermittent instruction to put vehicle in PARK when trying to start or shut down when in PARK already. 2. Intermittent NO REMOTE DETECTED when remote is in the car
Shift car issues. The car would not shut off because it doesnât recognize that the gear is in parking.
Intermittent shift to park message when in park. Unable to turn off vehicle.

Battery fire recall. Dealer limited the battery full charge to 90% in november 2020.gm promised a fix by first of 2021. No fix as of this date and my driving range is limited and now requires frequent charging.

Vehicle is useless to me due to the new range restrictions. My medical provider is a little over 100 miles away, and I cannot make the round trip with the reduced range, thus I cannot get my prescription medications.
Incident hasn't occurred YET. Worried about car and property. Leaving car outside is an invitation for car thieves in our area and we're having major hail storms.
Vehicle will not charge fully due to battery catching on fire

GM's recall solution is unacceptable and leaves consumers with virtually unusable vehicles if they follow GM's safety recommendations. This situation has been allowed to go on too long and we are lucky that no one has gotten hurt.

2022 Chevrolet Bolt. Consumer writes in regard to NHTSA safety recall 21v-650 being incomplete. The consumer stated the manufacturer exceeded a reasonable amount of time completing/determining a fix for the recall repair.
Vehicle stopped while driving down the road lost power threw up multiple codes and was stuck in the middle of the roadway!

Firstly, day/night sensor failure caused failure in left front headlamp turn signal system. This was repaired successfully. Secondly, Airbag system failure that I saw was a common problem across many vehicles.
vehicle change to limp mode randomly. i need to stop turn all off wait 1 minute to restables the normal power on engine.

The front passenger side A-pillar molding flew off while driving in windy weather. This piece could have hit another vehicle and impeded their vision while driving. The molding was not otherwise compromised.
Windshield cracks randomly with no point of impact. Frays outward. Seems to be stress fracture from the frame. Happened multiple times with 2020 nissans
This is the fourth lugnut/stud that has failed. This time it was during routine maintenance at an authorized dealership during tire rotation.
The car was involved in a major accident. The car hit a fence knocked it down & hit a tree it is completely inoperable. The car was totaled. None of the airbags deployed.
Was run off the road at 55 mph hitting a stop sign a telephone box a oak tree then a pine tree and the airbags did not deploy or did the seat belts lock up wife has a broken back and chest bone

Uneven premature brake wear. Right front and right rear pads and rotors worn beyond limits in 28,000miles of lite freeway driving. Left front and Left rear only half worn. Engine has multiple oil leaks.
Engine oil low warning 2k miles after oil change and again a week after topping oil off.
Low engine oil light came on at around 13,700. Last oil change was at 10,000 miles. Checked oil dipstick, oil level slightly below first marker hole.
Low oil light comes on. Using excessive oil between oil changes.
Car stalls without notice any time. Has trouble starting back once it has stalled. Transmissions jumps/shifts hard daily (once or twice daily)

My rotors warped with 5,260 miles and dealership would not cover the issue stating it is wear and tear. The brembo brake calipers are large and creates to much heat and causes the rotors to overheat and warp.
Bmw refuses to let me out of my lease but do not want to fix the defect because the parts are out of stock for several months. I have a small child and am afraid for our safety.
Takata recall have been waiting since feb 2016 for this issue to be resolved. Bmw has no idea when it will be resolved.

Takata recall - have asked about the replacement of the driver airbag as a recall item for almost one year with no resolution. Dealership states they get 20 replacement bags per month and I am on a waiting list. Very dangerous!
I was involved in an accident today and the front steering wheel airbags didnât deploy The blue car in the pictures turned in front of me and I hit them
Pirelli scorpion tire 235/55hr17 99h blow-outs in side walls.
Auto break suddenly activated during traffic with no obstruction ahead. Also Automatic Headlamp Mode Inoperative comes on and off
Backup Camera doesn't engage when putting the car in reverse. It's a completely blank screen.
Have replace 5 tires since April 2024 due to damage from pot holes
Pre safe functions limited error message repeatedly comes on and loses acceleration.
2006 Audi a3 3.2 quattro dsg transmission fails to engage when attempting to accelerate from a stop. Transmission also upshifts and down shifts abruptly during routine driving.
From a stop, or slow speeds, transmission was lurching w/out an apparent pattern.
2010 Audi a3 tdi high pressure fuel pump failure at 10,000 mi.
2010 Audi a-3 tdi (diesel) stalled while driving on freeway. Will not start. Towed to stevens creek Audi, ca.
Driving on local street at ~35mph, car suddenly would not accelerate, loss power, then stalled. Unable to restart engine.
1) normal driving. 2) fuel pump failure resulting in total fuel system failure. 3) fuel pump and entire fuel delivery system replaced.
Fuel pump imploded and sent shrapnel throughout the entire fuel system. Everything had to be replaced.

The vehicle started loosing power and stalling. The engine light came up. I took the car the dealer. They diagnosed the problem as a high-pressure fuel pump that has disintegrated and damaged the entire fuel system.
Nothing has happened yet, but my airbag was recalled 6 months ago and I haven't been notified of any fix available. Please advise.

While at a complete stop at a red light, I felt what I can only describe as a "clunk" and the battery light on my dashboard illuminated. The car had stalled, and I had to restart the car entirely in order to continue on my way.
Takata recall- 16v079 recall date: february 9, 2016 my vehicle is almost 4 years old and no due diligence has been taken to remedy this unsafe and possibly defective airbag.
Audi is unable to provide a remedy for the pods recall in a timely manner making my Audi a3 unsafe for passengers sitting in the front passenger seat.

Audi has stated there are no parts available to address the PODS recall 21V198 since March 2021. My dealership sold my vehicle to me at the end of my lease without having addressed this safety recall.

My car keeps throwing drive errors, system malfunctions, and throws no trouble codes? I brought this to the attention of Audi, and got no answer. Can you investigate a hacked tcu/ecu? I don't have the gear.
Nothing has happened (Yet), but Audi has still not come up with a fix for this problem since March 2021. This is real safety concern for front passengers in the 2020 Audi A3 autos.
While driving the alternator failed. The battery also failed. Multiple instances at the dealer trying to repair.
Random Errors for front and rear sensors, ABS light for brake booster error and SOS failure.

quotes.text: I have attempted to get my brakes repaired on a 2008 Audi q7. I have taken it to two different service centers with 2 visits to each one. None of them have fixed the problems completely.
Engine start button: within 9,800 miles, the esb started to be inoperable. Very inconvenient. It is currently being diagnosed at the moment.
Gas pipe above the engine popped when trying to start the car and all the gas leaked out. Might have caught on fire if the engine was hot.
Emergency battery light came on with a description of power malfunction. The light went from yellow to red then shortly stopped in the road while driving with complete power outage.

The mechatronic unit in my dsg transmission was found to be defective. It would cause the car to shudder and jerk back and forth when starting from a dead stop. It would also do the same thing while in reverse.
